title: Public raw-carrier post-callback mutation boundary
scope: Document the exact scope of the DXF read-retention lease for public raw carriers
Avoid claiming that a read-time lease constrains caller-owned post-callback mutation or memory capacity

implementation.contract: The shared lease covers library-owned parsed logical string copies. Public carrier fields can be edited or copied by the consumer after callback publication; caller-owned growth is outside the source-read budget and is not monitored for allocator capacity or RSS.
